faqs.q: What does setup look like at a downtown Denver hotel?
faqs.a: Through the dock and the service elevator, inside the windows the venue sets, and the banquet team wants footprint, power and timing before either is confirmed, so we settle all three before the day. A quartet takes about 14 by 10 feet, 90 minutes and two dedicated 20-amp circuits; a duo takes 8 by 6 feet, one circuit and an hour. Sharing a circuit with catering warmers is the usual cause of trouble, so ask for dedicated lines. Signet Artists books company parties across Denver.
Through dinner and the remarks, quiet enough that a table talks across it; once the program ends, a quartet or the DJ plays like a dance floor, up to what the hotel allows.

faqs.q: Do December dates in Denver cost more?
faqs.a: Yes. December weekends cost more than a standard date everywhere in this market, and New Year's Eve is a peak date of its own. What that means for your date is its own line on the quote.
